summary: Jenkinsfile.iac-apply now plans terraform/prd, runs check-protected-vms.sh and applies that saved /tmp/plan.tfplan in one stage and one iac call, so a refused plan or a failing guard applies nothing. An offline sidecar test of the body taken from the Jenkinsfile passed every case: create, no change, refused replace, guard exit 1 and 2, and a config edited after the plan that stayed out of the apply. The root gate has no test statements, so it skipped.
